items.title: Return signed enrolment agreement
items.quote:
To accept the place, please sign both copies and return one of them to the admissions
office by 06/07/2027.
items.computation: The letter states a fixed calendar deadline '06/07/2027' rather than a period to count from delivery, so no Bekanntgabefiktion or §187/188 BGB counting applies. However, the date format is ambiguous: the school's own letterhead date is printed the same way ('Date 05/05/2027'), which could be DD/MM/YYYY (5 May) or MM/DD/YYYY (5 May, same either way since day=month). For the deadline '06/07/2027', a DD/MM reading gives 6 July 2027, while a MM/DD reading gives 7 June 2027. Since the start date cannot be disambiguated and the rule is to use the earliest plausible reading when a numeric date can be read two ways, I take 7 June 2027 as the due date. This is a private deadline set by a company (school), so it is not shifted for weekends/holidays unless the letter says so; 7 June 2027 is a Monday in any case, so no adjustment would be needed even under the other reading region.

warnings: The deadline date '06/07/2027' is printed in an ambiguous numeric format (could be DD/MM/YYYY = 6 July 2027, or MM/DD/YYYY = 7 June 2027); I used the earlier reading (7 June 2027) with low confidence — please check the enclosed enrolment agreement or contact the school to confirm the exact deadline.
The letter's own date (05/05/2027) is also in this ambiguous slash format, though day and month coincide (5) so it is not itself ambiguous.
No fee amounts are stated in the letter text itself; the fee schedule mentioned is an enclosure not reproduced here, so amounts could not be extracted.
